name: io.github.vish288/mcp-gitlab
description: GitLab MCP server (MCP 2026-07-28): projects, MRs, pipelines, CI/CD, issues; writes or read-only

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab personal access token (token mode). Optional after `mcp-gitlab auth login`; also accepts GITLAB_PAT, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, GITLAB_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Alias for MCP_READ_ONLY. Any value other than false/0/no/off/empty locks the server read-only; --read-only can only raise the lock

environmentVariables.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Locks the server read-only: write tools and write-workflow prompts are not listed and nothing lifts the lock at runtime. Shared name across the mcp-* servers; set it in the deployer's env

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: token (default) or oauth (OAuth 2.1 proxy; streamable-http only)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application ID of the GitLab OAuth app (oauth mode, or local sign-in on a self-managed instance)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret of the GitLab OAuth app (oauth mode)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of this server, no trailing slash (oauth mode); redirect URI is <base>/auth/callback

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Space-separated GitLab scopes required on every request (oauth mode; default api)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_JWT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: FastMCP JWT signing key, >=32 random chars (oauth mode; defaults to one derived from the client secret)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token (min 16 chars) required to bind an HTTP transport to a non-loopback host; clients send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (token mode; --auth oauth has its own sign-in)
